evidence: Matches the Tests label and adds new benchmarks in src/bench/bip352.cpp and src/bench/CMakeLists.txt, which are explicitly covered under test infrastructure.
rationale: Adds microbenchmarks measuring Silent Payments public key extraction across standard and adversarial worst-case inputs. As the PR notes ongoing work on GetPubKeyFromInput (#36338, #36417), having dedicated benchmarks protects against performance regressions, though review is reasonably deferrable.
